events.vwap: Close outside a 2 SD band. Intraday band is the session VWAP. Daily band is the 20-day volume-weighted average.
events.atr: Intraday only. Close is at least 1.0 or 1.5 prior-day ATRs off the session high or low.
events.gap: Open is at least 1 prior-day ATR through the prior close.
events.multi: Daily only. Three-session move of at least 1.5 prior ATRs.

trade: Next-bar confirmation, stop beyond the event extreme, target the mean, flat at the session close or after 3 daily bars.
